ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in the Minnesota Somali Community
ideas.description: This story would investigate allegations of fraud in the Minnesota Somali community, following the money trail to uncover potential wrongdoing.
questions: What are the allegations of fraud in the Minnesota Somali community?
